# Observing raw boundary source replay

The source in first/main.qli was authored using known executable std operations
and saved before its initial check. The checker accepted it. Session metadata
was assembled later: the procedure's pre-check context-recording requirement
was missed for that initial check. Its raw output is not reconstructed here.
This session records a curated replay, not a prospective authoring experiment.

Available context included repository specifications, current Rust verification,
VM-25 and the developing VM-26 modules, prior corpus/branch examples and known
ownership/SSA rules. The intended executable source measures a fresh H state,
branches on that classical bit while retaining the quantum owner, then measures
the joined owner. No unsupported desired syntax or source repair was attempted.

attempt-01 is a byte-for-byte copy of the retained first project, made when this
metadata was assembled. The observation is an actual later checker replay and
is labeled accordingly. Native QIRF/independent operator comparisons are linked
separately in verification_v026. They are not algorithm proofs or source
preservation theorems. No external model was invoked; exact model identifier,
sampling configuration and a controlled benchmark context are unavailable.
